theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_cp_measurable_glue
theorems.statement: ∀ (m P : ℕ) (Y : ℕ → Set (Euclid m)) (ψ Φ : ℕ → Euclid m → Euclid P), (∀ j, MeasurableSet (Y j) ∧ ContinuousOn (ψ j) (Y j) ∧ InjOn (ψ j) (Y j) ∧ ContinuousOn (Φ j) (Y j)) → Pairwise (fun i j => Disjoint (ψ i '' Y i) (ψ j '' Y j)) → ∃ g : Euclid P → Euclid P, Measurable g ∧ (∀ j, ∀ y ∈ Y j, g (ψ j y) = Φ j y) ∧ ∀ x, (∀ j, x ∉ ψ j '' Y j) → g x = 0
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
